page_data.en:
Gambling Dives To Be
Cleaned Up By Nipponese

Rumours have been in circulation for some time past
that the notorious "Badlands," situated in the Extra-Settle-
ment Roads area in the Western District, which have gained
an unenviable reputation during the past two years as a
cesspool of every form of vice, including gambling, opium
and heroin smoking and prostitution, would be "cleaned up."

Much speculation has been rife as
to the correctness of such reports
owing to the fact that as recently
as at the Spring Festival Season
(Chinese New Year) which has just
passed, a new million dollar "gamb-
ling joint," was added to the dozens
already in operation.

However, the Japanese military
spokesman stated at the press con-
ference the day before yesterday
that steps would be taken by the
Special Service Section of the Jap-
anese Army to close these dens of
vice, but no intimation was given
as to when such action would com-
mence.

Tokyo Decides

The Evening Echo is in a
position to announce that this
step was decided upon follow-
ing the return from Tokyo
of Mr. Sasaki, the licencing
officer in charge of these establish-
ments, and that a general "clean
up" of the large gambling houses
situated on the main Extra-Settle-
ment roads will definitely commence
on March 1st and that this will be
followed by the systematic closure
of the scores of smaller "joints"
which infest the alleyways in the
enclaves.

The Evening Echo is also able de-
finitely to refute the rumours that
these vice dens would be closed in
the Western District only to open
in Nantao.

No Foundation

These reports are entirely with-
out foundation and probably found
their inception in the fact that only
recently large sums had been sunk
in the Badlands in setting up still
more dens of vice, and it was
doubtless presumed that such risks
would not have been taken had not
those who put up the capital been
tolerably certain of being able to
transfer their establishments to
some other site, in the event of a
"clean up" being decided upon in
the Extra-Settlement area.

This clearing of the Augean
stables affects not only the gamb-
ling houses but will bring to an end
the countless opium and heroin
dens and houses of ill-fame which
infested the district.

Welcome Step

This welcome step will be carried
out by the Japanese authorities as
a part of the agreement recently
reached between the Shanghai Mu-
nicipal Council and Mr. Fu Hsiao,
Mayor of the Shanghai Special

Municipality, concerning the polic-
ing of the Extra-Settlement Roads
area as exclusively reported in the
Evening Echo last Monday, and re-
flects their anxiety to suppress vice
and to restore law and order in
these areas.

Millions of dollars have been
squandered in gambling and other
forms of vice; thousands have been
ruined and dozens of suicides can
be traced directly to these estab-
lishments, which have been the
cause of numerous murders and
robberies with violence.

Embezzlements

Many business establishments
have suffered severely through the
embezzlements of their employees
who became stricken with the "get-
rich-quick" fever which these glit-
tering dens of vice appeared to of-
fer a chance to satisfy.

The alleyways leading into the
enclaves in the Extra-Settlement
Roads area provided convenient
bolt-holes for swarms of armed
gangsters, who perpetrated their
crimes, frequently in the Settlement
and Concession, after which they
made rapid tracks for this sanc-
tuary, once within which they felt
safe from the attentions of the cus-
todians of the law.

Immunity From Arrest

The wave of crime which has
swept over Shanghai during the
past couple of years was doubtless
due to a great extent to the com-
parative immunity from arrest
which this area afforded to the
thousands of ruffians who have
preyed on the community and has
placed tremendous obstacles in the
way of the police forces in their
efforts to keep down crime.

A sigh of relief will doubtless be
indulged in by all residents of the
Western district, both foreign and
Chinese, at the prospect of peace
and order again being restored and
great credit must be given to the
Japanese authorities for their de-
termined effort to write "finis" on
this dark chapter in the history of
Shanghai crime.

It may be recorded that similar
steps were taken in Harbin, once a
city notorious for its vice dens,
which is now a model so far as the
absence of crime is concerned.
page_data.zh:
日方将整顿赌博窝点

过去一段时间以来，一直有谣言流传称，位于西区越界筑路区域、臭名昭著的“恶土”（Badlands）将被“清理”。该地区在过去两年中因成为包括赌博、吸食鸦片和海洛因以及卖淫在内的各种罪恶活动的污水池而声名狼藉。

由于就在刚刚过去的春节（中国新年）期间，又有了一家新的耗资百万美元的“赌博场所”加入已在运营的数十家之中，因此关于此类报道真实性的猜测甚嚣尘上。

然而，日本军方发言人在前天的新闻发布会上表示，日本陆军特务机关将采取措施关闭这些罪恶巢穴，但未透露行动何时开始。

东京方面作出决定

《晚声报》（The Evening Echo）获悉，这一决定是在负责管理这些场所的许可官佐佐木（Sasaki，音译）先生从东京返回后作出的；位于主要越界筑路道路上的大型赌场将于3月1日正式开始全面“清理”，随后将系统地关闭充斥于各飞地小巷中的数十家小型“场所”。

《晚声报》还能明确驳斥有关这些罪恶巢穴仅在西区关闭、却在南市重新开放的谣言。

毫无根据

这些报道完全毫无根据，其产生可能源于这样一个事实：近期有人在“恶土”投入巨资设立更多的罪恶巢穴，人们无疑推测，除非出资者相当确信一旦决定在越界筑路区域进行“清理”时能够将其场所转移至其他地点，否则他们不会冒此风险。

这次对“奥吉亚斯牛圈”的清理不仅影响赌场，还将终结充斥该地区的无数鸦片和海洛因烟馆以及妓院。

受欢迎的一步

作为上海公共租界工部局与上海特别市市长傅筱庵先生之间就 exclusively 由《晚声报》于上周一报道的越界筑路区域警务问题达成的最新协议的一部分，日本当局将执行这一受欢迎的举措，这反映了他们镇压罪恶并恢复这些地区法律与秩序的迫切心情。

数百万美元被挥霍在赌博和其他形式的罪恶活动中；成千上万的人因此毁灭，数十起自杀事件可直接归咎于这些场所，它们还导致了众多的谋杀和暴力抢劫案件。

挪用公款

许多商号因其雇员挪用公款而遭受严重损失，这些雇员染上了“快速致富”的热病，而这些光鲜亮丽的罪恶巢穴似乎提供了满足这种欲望的机会。

通往越界筑路区域各飞地的小巷为成群结队的武装匪徒提供了便捷的藏身之所，他们经常在租界和法租界实施犯罪，然后迅速逃往这个避难所，一旦进入其中，他们便觉得可以免受执法者的追究。

免于逮捕

过去两年席卷上海的犯罪浪潮，无疑在很大程度上是由于该区域为数千名掠夺社会的流氓提供了相对的免捕特权，这给警方维持治安的努力设置了巨大的障碍。

随着和平与秩序有望再次恢复，西区的所有居民，无论是外籍人士还是中国人，无疑都会松一口气；必须高度赞扬日本当局决心在上海犯罪史上为这一黑暗篇章画上句号的努力。

值得一提的是，哈尔滨曾以罪恶巢穴众多而闻名，如今在杜绝犯罪方面已成为模范城市，当时也采取了类似的措施。

page_data.en:
16 1 3 1940

Western Area Gambling May
Close By End Of Month

Rumour Spreading That Early Signing Of Outside
Roads Agreement May Put All Gambling And
Drug Dens In West Out Of Business

Will all the gambling dens along
the Outside Roads Area as well as
the drug dens be closed by Febru-
ary 29? That is the question that
is being asked by the operators
and employees of the various
gambling establishments in the
western area during the past several
days.
A strong rumour has been
spread over the city that February
29 will be the deadline fixed for
the closure of all the dens—
gambling and opium—in the western
district. Whether the order, if it
does go into effect, will be the re-
sult of successful negotiations be-
tween the Shanghai City Govern-
ment, headed by Mayor Fu Siao-
cn, and the Shanghai Municipal
Council, for the conclusion of the
"outside roads" agreement or whe-
ther the step will be taken by the
City Government authorities in
order to speed up the negotiations
is not known.
No official confirmation or denial
of the rumour could be obtained
yesterday from any source. Most
of the officials stated that they had
heard of the rumour but that they
could neither confirm nor deny it.
Should the order for the closure
of all gambling and opium dens in
the Western Area materialize, then
it is believed likely that the gam-
blers and narcotic traffickers will
move over to Nantao. Here, how-
ever, a hitch is likely to occur, as,
since the opening of the former
walled city a new and independent
Amusement Resort Supervisor's
Office has been set up and operates
completely independently from such
an office in the western area of
Shanghai.

May Move Elsewhere

The various persons and organiza-
tions heading the gambling dens in
the western area will be putting up
strong arguments to those in auth-
ority against the closure of these
dens using as a strong argument
the amount of money that it brings
in for charity and that it provides
employment for thousands of men
and women.
Of late new establishments—
especially high class places—have
been springing up like mushrooms
and it is rumoured that licences
were granted to numerous places
in the past months in order to
make it harder to effect a closure,
should such an order be given.
During the next fortnight a close
watch will be kept on any develop-
ments and it will probably require
more than police to close down
all the gambling dens in one night.
page_data.zh:
1940年1月16日

西区赌博活动可能在月底前关闭

谣言传播称，尽早签署越界筑路协议可能导致西区所有赌博和毒品窝点停业

沿越界筑路区域的所有赌博窝点以及毒品窝点是否会在2月29日前关闭？这是过去几天里西区各家赌博场所的经营者和员工一直在问的问题。

全市流传着一个强烈的谣言，称2月29日将是关闭西区所有窝点——包括赌博和鸦片窝点——的最后期限。如果该命令生效，究竟是上海市市长傅筱庵领导的上海市政府与上海公共租界工部局就达成“越界筑路”协议进行成功谈判的结果，还是市政府当局为加速谈判而采取的步骤，目前尚不清楚。

昨天未能从任何渠道获得对该谣言的官方证实或否认。大多数官员表示，他们听说了这一谣言，但既无法证实也无法否认。

如果关闭西区所有赌博和鸦片窝点的命令成为现实，那么赌徒和毒品贩子很可能会转移到南市。然而，这里可能会出现阻碍，因为自从原城墙内的旧城开放以来，已经设立了一个新的、独立的游乐业管理处，该处完全独立于上海西区的同类机构运作。

可能迁往他处

西区各家赌博窝点的负责人和组织者将向当局提出强有力的反对关闭这些窝点的理由，其主要论点是这些场所为慈善事业带来了大量资金，并为成千上万的男女提供了就业机会。

最近，新的场所——尤其是高档场所——如雨后春笋般涌现，有谣言称，在过去几个月里，许多场所获得了执照，目的是使得一旦下达此类命令，更难实施关闭。

在未来两周内，将密切关注任何事态发展，要在一夜之间关闭所有赌博窝点，可能仅靠警察力量是不够的。

FEB 1 2 1940

I'VE OFTEN WONDERED    BY CARROLL D. ALCOTT

New Gambling Den
RUMORS are going the rounds that one of our leading gambling den proprietors is moving a couple of roulette wheels into the center of the Settlement from his establishment on the outskirts of the city. In fact, one report has it that he moved the wheels of fortune into the Settlement a few nights back.
Some people are just naturally hoggish. Not content with getting half the money in the city, they want it all. If this sort of thing keeps up, the churches and temples will have to run wheels and black-jack games as a matter of self-protection.

（批：FILE）
（批：Visa. 13/2）

1940年2月12日

我常常在想    作者：卡罗尔·D·奥尔科特 (Carroll D. Alcott)

新赌博窝点
谣言四起，称我们一位主要的赌博窝点老板正将几个轮盘赌桌从他在市郊的场所搬进租界中心。事实上，有报告称他几天前就把这些“命运之轮”搬进了租界。
有些人天生就是贪得无厌。不满足于拿走城里一半的钱，他们想要全部。如果这种情况持续下去，教堂和寺庙为了自我保护，也不得不经营轮盘赌和二十一点游戏了。

（批注：归档）

page_data.en:
Feb. 6, 40.
Woo Wan News Agency - Release of unfounded report re bombing
of Hwo Hwei Lottery House on Robison Road on January 30, 1940.

On January 31, 1940, the Sin Wan Pao (新闻报)
and the National Herald (神州日报), both foreign
operated Chinese language dailies, published an article
relating to the alleged bombing of the Hwo Hwei
Lottery House, conducted by Mao Ah-siang (毛阿祥),
in the Kung Yih Lee (公益里), Robison Road.

Investigations by S. I revealed the story as
entirely false, in consequence of which this Section
undertook enquiries with a view to finding out the
source of the information.

Neither Chiang Tsung-nyi (蒋宗义) nor Sung
Siao-yen (宋小雁), two newspaper reporters mentioned
in the report by D.S.I. Liao Chung-chien dated 2.2.40
have been so far proved as being concerned with the
fabrication of the report, despite their habit of
frequenting the gambling dens and lottery houses in
the extra-Settlement area.

The information was supplied by the Woo Wan
News Agency (沪闻通讯社) of 14/55 Museum Road. The
proprietor of the agency, Ming Ching-sum (闵静声),
was called to Headquarters on February 5th and asked
to divulge the source of his information. He
explained that the item had been prepared from an
original report by one Lieu Shih-fang (刘世芳), a
part time reporter residing in the Tai Shing Chun
(泰兴村), Robison Road, which individual has so far
not been interviewed.

1940年2月6日。
沪闻通讯社 - 关于1940年1月30日罗宾森路（Robison Road）华惠彩票行遭轰炸的不实报道发布。

1940年1月31日，两家由外国人经营的中文日报《新闻报》和《神州日报》刊登了一篇关于据称发生在罗宾森路公益里、由毛阿祥经营的华惠彩票行遭轰炸的文章。

特别调查员（S.I.）的调查揭示该故事完全虚假，因此本科展开查询，旨在找出信息来源。

尽管廖仲坚（Liao Chung-chien，音译）侦探副督察在1940年2月2日的报告中提到的两名报纸记者蒋宗义和宋小雁（Sung Siao-yen，音译）有频繁出入越界筑路区赌博窝点和彩票行的习惯，但截至目前，尚未证明他们参与编造该报道。

该信息由位于博物馆路14/55号的沪闻通讯社提供。该社社长闵静声于2月5日被传唤至总部，并被要求披露其信息来源。他解释说，该条目是根据居住在罗宾森路泰兴村的兼职记者刘世芳（Lieu Shih-fang，音译）的原始报告编写的，此人至今尚未接受问询。

- 2 -

Ming Ching-sun was informed that the story
was absolutely untrue and that a correction would have
to appear in to-day's issue of the two papers concerned.
Correction appears in the National Herald only, the
Sin Wan Pao having suspended operation till after
the Chinese New Year.

Before leaving Headquarters, Ming Ching-sun
was informed that the dissemination of untrue or
exaggerated reports was a very serious offence and
that any repetition of the type of deliberate rumour-
mongering under report might well spell the suspension
of the agency.

Copies of this report are forwarded for
attachment to the various files concerned.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

闵静声（Ming Ching-sun，音译）被告知该故事绝对不实，且必须在当天相关两家报纸的版本中刊登更正声明。更正声明仅刊登在《神州日报》上，《新闻报》因春节暂停出版直至节后。

在离开总部前，闵静声被告知，散布不实或夸大报道是非常严重的罪行，任何重复此类蓄意造谣的行为都可能导致该通讯社被勒令停业。

本报告副本已转发，附于相关各卷宗之后。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch Station 4
REPORT
File No. LIBRY
6239/1/41(C)·C
Date February 2, 1940.

Subject Alleged bombing of Hwo Wei Lottery Headquarters and
Yung Yuen Gambling Den.

Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung-chien. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached translation of
an extract from the National Herald dated 31-1-40 on
the explosion of bombs in the Yih Kee Hwo Wei Lottery
Headquarters, situated in Kung Yih Li (公益里),
off Robison Road, O.O.L., and the Yung Yuen Gambling
Den, Yung Yuen Fang (永源坊) off Bubbling Well
Road, O.O.L., on January 30, 1940, enquiries reveal
that the report is untrue and is believed to have
been fabricated by two newspaper reporters named Chiang
Tsung Nyi (蒋忠義) and Sing Siao Yen (盛小仁).
It is reported that during the past
fortnight, many newspaper reporters have approached
the Hwo Wei Lottery Headquarters and gambling dens in
the Western District with a view to soliciting new
year gifts. The gambling dens which are said to have
received instructions from the Amusement Supervision
Department, 9/470 Yu Yuen Road, to abolish such illegal
seasonal gifts, have generally declined the request
to the great dissatisfaction of the newspaper reporters,
among whom Chiang Tsung Nyi and Sung Siao Yen are the
most disgruntled. The report of explosion of bombs
in the Hwo Wei Lottery Headquarters was therefore made
in revenge with a view to causing embarrassment to the
management.

(批：File. R.D.Y. 3/2)

日期：1940年2月2日。

主题：关于华惠彩票总部和永源赌博窝点遭轰炸的指控。

由侦探副督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung-chien，音译）制作。由侦探督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈。

关于附带的1940年1月31日《神州日报》摘录译文，内容涉及1940年1月30日发生在越界筑路区罗宾森路旁公益里的益记华惠彩票总部，以及越界筑路区静安寺路旁永源坊的永源赌博窝点的炸弹爆炸事件，经查证，该报道不实，据信是由两名名为蒋忠义和盛小仁（Sing Siao Yen，音译）的报纸记者编造的。

据报道，在过去两周里，许多报纸记者前往华惠彩票总部和西区的赌博窝点，意在索取新年礼金。据说已从愚园路9/470号游乐业管理处接到废除这种非法季节性礼金指令的赌博窝点，普遍拒绝了这一请求，引起记者们的极大不满，其中蒋忠义和宋小雁（Sung Siao Yen，音译）最为愤懑。因此，编造华惠彩票总部爆炸报道是出于报复，旨在使管理层陷入尴尬境地。

（批注：归档。R.D.Y. 2月3日）

（印章：归档）
（批注：C. 2月3日。侦探副督察科尔昆（Colquhoun）。）

January 31, 1940.
Morning Translation.

National Herald and Sin Wen Pao :-

HWO HWEI LOTTERY HEADQUARTERS IN WESTERN DISTRICT
BOMBED

At about 6 p.m. yesterday when a drawing
of the lottery was taking place at the Yih Kee (益記) Hwo
Hwei Lottery Headquarters conducted by Mao Ah-ziang (毛阿祥)
at Kung Yih Lee (公益里) on Robison Road, a large hand
grenade was hurled into the premises by some unknown persons.
The explosion injured more than 20 of the messengers who
had gathered at the place to learn the result of the drawing.
Upon learning of the incident, a party of
Japanese and puppet officers were rushed to the place where
they conducted a rigorous search, but no arrests were made.
The injured men were later removed to various hospitals for
treatment. Many of them are said to be in a critical condition.
Another bomb explosion took place at the
Yung Yuen (永源) gambling den at Yung An Fang (永安坊),
Bubbling Well Road, at about 9 p.m. yesterday when gambling
was going on full swing and the place was packed with gamblers.
Two hand grenades were said to have been thrown into the
place, resulting in the wounding of many gamblers, while some
received minor injuries. Great excitement prevailed. When
the Japanese and puppets arrived at the place, all the gambler
had already left. The injured gamblers were later removed
to hospital for treatment.

1940年1月31日。
晨间译件。

《国民新闻报》及《辛闻报》：-

西区华惠彩票总部遭炸弹袭击

昨日下午6时许，当毛阿祥（Mao Ah-ziang）在罗便臣路（Robison Road）公益里（Kung Yih Lee）经营的益記（Yih Kee）华惠彩票总部进行开奖时，数名不明身份者向场内投掷了一枚大型手榴弹。爆炸致使聚集在该处等待开奖结果的20多名信差受伤。获悉此事后，一队日本人和伪政权警官迅速赶至现场进行了严密搜查，但未实施逮捕。伤者随后被送往各家医院接受治疗。据称，其中许多人情况危急。

昨晚9时许，另一宗炸弹爆炸事件发生在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）永安坊（Yung An Fang）的永源（Yung Yuen）赌窟内，当时赌博活动正酣，场内挤满了赌徒。据称有两枚手榴弹被投入该处，导致许多赌徒受伤，部分人受轻伤。现场一片混乱。当日本人和伪政权人员到达现场时，所有赌徒已逃离。受伤的赌徒随后被送往医院治疗。

Crystal (晶報), a mosquito paper, published the following
article on January 30 :-

GAMBLING DENS IN WESTERN DISTRICT

    During the past few months many large gambling
dens have been established in the Western District and are
said to be all doing good business.
    Formerly the Asia Club (亞洲總會) at No. 65
Gordon Road was doing the best business among all gambling
establishments, but now it has been surpassed by the Chiu
Yuan (秋園) gambling den at No. 15 Jessfield Road,
because the latter is not so strict as the former in the
checking up of the membership cards of the visitors.
Moreover, callers to and from this gambling den are provided
with the convenience of free transportation by motor cars
with black number plates, belonging to six local motor car
garages. The cars provided by the Asia Club for the
conveyance of its clients are those of the Silver Taxi
Service. Though the callers are accorded this facility free
of charge, they are, however, required to undergo a strict
inspection of their membership passes.
    The Chiu Yuan gambling den was originally the
private residence of a Cantonese named Tan Hai-chiu (譚海秋).
It occupies a large area and is said to be the largest of
all gambling dens in the Western District. It is under the
management of a Westerner and many students of the University
of Shanghai and of Soochow Law College are said to be
making a living with this gambling den. It offers a game
called "Russian dominoes," which is not used in other
gambling establishments. It also provides tables for "Bah-
Chiu" games with paper cards. This game is said to be
attracting quite a large patronage.
    The third gambling den that enjoys a similar
notoriety as the above two is the one located at No. 626
Avenue Haig. It also occupies a large area but due to its
location which is rather too remote, it is less favoured
by the gamblers.
    Recently another gambling den known as Yih Loo
(亦廬) was established at No. 368 Avenue Haig. The Lien
Wei Loo (利匯廬) better known as the Hollywood (好萊塢)
is now rather too old, but it still does a good business in
the daytime. The Wei Loh Kung (會樂宮) which was newly
established on Great Western Road is conducted by the
proprietor of the Hollywood. It is well built and provides
a dancing floor and story-telling rooms, but its business
is not so prosperous as expected. The Yu Yuen Hotel
(豫園大飯店) at the corner of Bubbling Well and Tseng Roads
was opened only recently. It is not well furnished and yet
its business is quite above the average, presumably due to
convenience of communications.
    In addition to the above, there is also one
called the Monte Carlo which was originally known as the
Yung Sung Company (榮生公司). It is also doing a good
business, but the patrons of this den are mostly persons of
inferior class and therefore the establishment has not the
status of the Asia Club or the Chiu Yuan gambling den.

小报《晶报》（Crystal）于1月30日刊登了以下文章：-

西区赌窟

    在过去几个月里，西区开设了许多大型赌窟，据说生意都很兴隆。
    以前，戈登路（Gordon Road）65号的亚洲总会（Asia Club）在所有赌博场所中生意最好，但现在已被极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）15号的秋园（Chiu Yuan）赌窟超越，因为后者对访客会员证的检查不如前者严格。此外，往返该赌窟的客人可享受由六家本地汽车行提供的黑牌汽车免费接送的便利。亚洲总会为其客户提供的车辆则来自银色出租车服务（Silver Taxi Service）。虽然客人可免费享受此便利，但他们必须接受对其会员通行证的严格检查。
    秋园赌窟原为一名叫譚海秋（Tan Hai-chiu）的广东人的私人住宅。它占地面积很大，据说是西区所有赌窟中最大的一家。它由一名西人管理，据说许多沪江大学（University of Shanghai）和东吴法学院（Soochow Law College）的学生靠这家赌窟谋生。它提供一种名为“俄罗斯多米诺骨牌”的游戏，其他赌博场所不使用这种游戏。它还设有玩纸牌“八球”（Bah-Chiu）游戏的桌子。据说这种游戏吸引了相当多的顾客。
    第三家享有与上述两家同样恶名的赌窟位于海格路（Avenue Haig）626号。它也占地面积很大，但由于位置较为偏僻，不太受赌徒青睐。
    最近，另一家名为亦廬（Yih Loo）的赌窟在海格路368号开业。利匯廬（Lien Wei Loo），更广为人知的名字是好莱坞（Hollywood），现在显得过于陈旧，但白天的生意仍然不错。会乐宫（Wei Loh Kung）是大西路（Great Western Road）上新近开设的，由好莱坞的老板经营。其建筑精良，设有舞池和说书房间，但生意不如预期繁荣。豫園大飯店（Yu Yuen Hotel）位于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）和曾路（Tseng Road）的拐角处，是最近才开业的。其设施并不豪华，但生意相当高于平均水平，大概是因为交通便利。
    除上述之外，还有一家名为蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）的赌窟，原名榮生公司（Yung Sung Company）。它的生意也不错，但该赌窟的顾客大多属于下层阶级，因此该场所不具备亚洲总会或秋园赌窟那样的地位。

THE "SZE WEN CHI" AMUSEMENT RESORT

The following advertisement published by the "Sze
Wen Chi" (詩文集), a so-called amusement resort located
at No.478 Yu Yuen Road, appeared in the "Shanghai Daily
News" (上海日報), a mosquito paper, on January 17, 1940:-
"We have ordered from the United States a specially
made and delicate piece of machinery for amusement purposes.
It is rarely seen in Shanghai and is worthy to be recognized
as a most wonderful instrument for amusement. It can be
used to play games similar to the 'Hwo Gee Tai' (a kind of
gambling game). Moreover, it is accurate and reliable
and immune from all malpractices. Patrons who have lost
in other games can regain their losses with this game. The
machine is now on display at this place and is ready for
use."

September 12, 1941.

Western Shanghai Area Special Police -
notice re suppression of illegal business

On September 10, a circular notice was issued
by the Western Shanghai Area Special Police Force
reiterating the order concerning the suppression of
gambling dens and opium establishments in the area
under its jurisdiction. The notice states that since
inauguration, the Western Shanghai Area Special Police
has rigidly enforced the order issued by the Ministry
of Police and the Shanghai City Government in respect
of suppression of illegal enterprises as stipulated
in the agreement governing the policing of western
area. Although all known establishments have been
eradicated, unruly elements may escape the attention
of Police by secretly operating gambling and opium
establishments. The notice concludes by stating that
persons who conduct gambling in ballrooms will be
severely punished and those who grant lease of their
houses for the establishment of gambling and opium dens
will be dealt with accordingly.

It is learned, however, that gambling continues
in the premises of the former Winter Garden, 1505 Yu
Yuen Road, O.O.L.

August 8, 1941.

OFF THE RECORD
NEWS BEHIND THE NEWS

Over A Tree
Yesterday's trouble at the Argentina Night Club, which was erroneously reported to be the result of a raid, actually developed when the servants of a Chinese in an adjoining compound felled a tree which crashed into the Argentina grounds, damaging some furniture.

The servants then arrived to cart off his tree, but a Russian watchman, named Sodnikoff, refused to let them have it unless he paid for the damage it had caused. The Chinese then left but soon returned with six policemen and a civilian who desired to beat up the watchman.

When the watchman indicated that he didn't care to be beaten up and the night club's book-keeper called the headquarters of the Western Area police force, the would-be "musclemen" disappeared.

The misunderstanding arose when the policemen were seen entering the compound of the Argentina Night Club, which conducts gambling openly, roulette, as well as Chinese dice games. The fact that the club is flourishing, gambling and all, in spite of Commissioner C.C. Pan's oft-repeated intention to close all such institutions, led to the report, when police were seen at the night club, that the Western District Police Chief had finally decided to transform words into action.

However, gambling will be on as usual at the Argentina tonight, making profits for its three owners—reported to be a Russian jeweler, another Russian, and a Rumanian dentist.
page_data.zh:
非正式记录
新闻背后的新闻

树梢之上
昨日阿根廷夜总会发生的纠纷，被误报为突击搜查的结果，实则起因是相邻院落中一名中国人的仆人砍倒了一棵树，树倒下砸入阿根廷夜总会场地，损坏了一些家具。

随后仆人们前来运走树木，但一名名叫 Sodnikoff 的俄罗斯看守拒绝让他们带走，除非赔偿造成的损失。该中国人随即离开，但很快带着六名警察和一名平民返回，意图殴打看守。

当看守表示不愿挨打，且夜总会的簿记员致电西区警察部队总部后，那些企图施暴的“打手”便消失了。

误解产生于人们看到警察进入阿根廷夜总会的院落，该夜总会公开进行轮盘赌以及中国骰子游戏等赌博活动。尽管 C.C. 潘处长多次重申要关闭此类机构，但该俱乐部包括赌博业务在内依然生意兴隆，这一事实导致当人们看到警察出现在夜总会时，便传出谣言称西区警察局长终于决定将言语转化为行动。

然而，今晚阿根廷夜总会的赌博仍将照常进行，为其三位所有者赚取利润——据报道分别是一名俄罗斯珠宝商、另一名俄罗斯人和一名罗马尼亚牙医。

Of West Area Game Dens

Writes To Doyen Of Consular Body Requesting
Him To Take Action Against Foreigners
Owning And Running Establishments

Protesting the alleged function-
ing in the Western District of
Shanghai of several gambling
establishments owned by foreigners
enjoying extraterritorial rights
Mayor Chen Kung-po of Greater
Shanghai was reported last night to
have sent on Friday a letter to Mr.
Poul Scheel, Doyen of the Consular
Body, requesting him to notify all
foreign gaming house operators to
abide by the modus vivendi agree-
ment signed between the Chinese
authorities and the Shanghai
Municipal Police.

The complete text of the letter
follows, according to the Central
Press:

"With reference to prohibit
gambling practice in the Western
Area, you were requested to notify
foreign residents of different
nationalities in Shanghai to observe
the regulations of the signed modus
vivendi agreement—stop gambling
and cease to indulge in similar
enterprises.

"Now, there are foreign nationals
of questionable characters opening
establishments for gambling pur-
poses in the Western Area. The
most noted ones are the "Argentine"
and "St. George" and a few other
secret dens operated under disguise,
by foreigners who rely on being
foreign nationals, so disobey Chinese
laws.

Police In Difficulty

"The police of the Western Area
has extreme difficulties to handle
such cases because it is necessary
to obtain first a search warrant
from the concerned Consulate before
any search of premises can be effect-
ed. These bad foreigners usually
depend on their extraterritorial pri-
vileges to carry on evil practices so
that a situation is created whereby
new gambling dens begin to operate
soon after old ones are raided.
Therefore, the gambling evil in the
Western Area can never be stopped,
and the police in the said area can
never carry out orders from this office

Foreigners To Be Arrested

"It is hereby decided that hence-
forth orders will be issued to the
Western Area Police to arrest
gamblers irrespective of their
nationalities and close down dens.
The concerned Consulates will be
notified later for transfer of
offenders of foreign nationality.
This method will facilitate the
functioning of the said prohibition
law and will help restore order.

"You are cordially invited to
transmit this information to par-
ties concerned. Thanking you for
your kind attention."

7月5日

《上海泰晤士报》
7月5日

市长抗议西区赌场运营

致领事团团长写信要求其采取行动对付拥有并经营这些场所的外国人

据昨晚报道，大上海市长陈公博就上海西区几家由享有治外法权的外国人拥有和经营的赌博场所 allegedly 运作一事提出抗议，并于周五致信领事团团长 Poul Scheel 先生，要求其通知所有外国赌场经营者遵守中国当局与上海公共租界工部局警务处签署的临时协议。

据中央通讯社报道，信件全文如下：

“关于禁止西区赌博行为一事，曾请阁下通知在上海的不同国籍外籍居民遵守已签署的临时协议规定——停止赌博并 cease 从事类似企业。

“现在，有一些品行可疑的外籍国民在西区开设赌博场所。其中最著名的是‘阿根廷’和‘圣乔治’，以及其他几家由外国人伪装经营的秘密赌场，这些外国人倚仗其外籍身份，从而违犯中国法律。

警方陷入困境

“西区警方在处理此类案件时面临极大困难，因为在进行任何场所搜查之前，必须首先从相关领事馆获得搜查令。这些不良外国人通常依赖其治外法权特权进行邪恶勾当，从而导致一种局面，即旧赌场被突击搜查后不久，新赌场又开始运营。因此，西区的赌博恶习永远无法制止，该地区的警方也永远无法执行本办公室的命令

逮捕外国人

“兹决定，此后将命令西区警察逮捕赌徒，不论其国籍，并关闭赌场。稍后将通知相关领事馆移交外籍罪犯。此方法将有助于上述禁令法律的执行，并有助于恢复秩序。

“诚邀阁下将此信息转达有关各方。感谢阁下的关注。”

page_data.en:
JUL 5 1941
To Curb Gambling
Mayor Writes
To Scheel For
Cooperation

As a further step toward the realization of the policy to suppress gambling and similar evils in the western district of Shanghai where some gambling houses owned and operated by foreigners are said to be still carrying on their business under the protection of extraterritoriality, Mayor Chen Kung-po sent a letter yesterday to Mr. Poul Scheel, Senior Consul-General, requesting him to notify all foreign residents to observe the terms of the modus vivendi signed between the Chinese authorities and the Shanghai Municipal Council, the Central Press reported last night. The full text of the letter, according to the news agency, is as follows:—

"With reference to prohibit gambling practice in the Western Area you were requested to notify the foreign residents of different nationalities in Shanghai to observe the regulations of the signed Modus Vivendi—stop gambling and cease to indulge in similar enterprises.

"Now, there are foreign nationals of questionable characters opening establishments for gambling purpose in the Western Area. The most noted ones are "Argentine" and "St. George" and few other secret dens operating under disguise rely on foreign nationals to disobey the Chinese laws.

Extreme Difficulties

"The police of the Western Area has extreme difficulties to handle such cases because it is necessary to obtain first a search warrant from the concerned consulate before to effect any search at the premises. These bad foreigners usually depend on this privilege to drag along their evil practice so it creates a situation that new gambling dens begin to operate soon after raids are over. Therefore the gambling evil in the Western Area can never be stopped and the police in the said area can never carry out orders from this office.

"It is hereby decided that henceforth orders will be issued to the Western Area Police to arrest the gamblers irrespective of their nationalities and close down the dens. The concerned consulates will be notified later for transfer offenders if gamblers of foreign nationals are involved, thus it would expedite the functioning of the said prohibition law and bringing the matter in order.

"You are cordially requested to transmit this communication to parties concerned and thanks for your kind attention."

1941年7月5日
为遏制赌博
市长致信
谢尔请求合作

据中央社昨晚报道，为进一步落实在上海西区取缔赌博及类似恶习的政策——据悉，一些由外国人拥有和经营的赌馆仍在治外法权的庇护下继续营业——陈公博市长昨日致函总领事保罗·谢尔（Poul Scheel）先生，请其通知所有外籍居民遵守中国当局与上海公共租界工部局签署的《临时协定》条款。据该通讯社称，信函全文如下：——

“关于禁止在西区进行赌博活动一事，曾请阁下通知在上海的各国籍外籍居民，遵守已签署的《临时协定》之规定——停止赌博并 cease 从事类似行业。

“目前，西区有一些品行可疑的外国人开设赌场。其中最著名的是‘阿根廷’（Argentine）和‘圣乔治’（St. George），另有少数其他秘密窝点伪装经营，依仗外籍身份违抗中国法律。

极度困难

“西区警方在处理此类案件时面临极大困难，因为在对场所进行搜查之前，必须先获得相关领事馆签发的搜查令。这些不良外籍人士通常依赖这一特权延续其非法勾当，导致每次突击搜查结束后，新的赌窝很快又重新开始运营。因此，西区的赌博恶习永远无法根除，该地区的警方也永远无法执行本办公室的命令。

“兹决定，此后将命令西区警方逮捕赌徒，不论其国籍为何，并关闭赌窝。若涉及外籍赌徒，随后将通知相关领事馆移交罪犯，以此加速上述禁赌法令的执行，使事态纳入正轨。

“恳请阁下将此函转达有关各方，并对阁下的关注表示感谢。”

JUN 1941

Move To End Farren's,
Eventail Gaming Made

Revealing that the first part of
the campaign to close down gam-
bling dens in the Western district
had been complete I, Mr. Pan Dah.
Commissioner of ne Western Area
Special Police force, declared that
the next move to close foreign-
operated establishments is now
underway and is expected to show
results within the next few days.
An official request, it is learned.
was made by Mayor Chen Kung-
po of the Shanghai Special Muni-
cipality to the Shanghai Consular
Body, urging the foreign consula:
representatives to curb gambling
dens still operating in the "outside
roads" by foreigners who en-
joy extrality rights.
A joint gambling enterprise
which was being sponsored by the
Chinese dens closed down last
week by the authorities. was est-
ablished at Del Monte's but re-
mained open only for one day.
Some new construction work
which had been carried out at the
premises were seen being taken
down this morning, and it is be-
lieved that the den will not open
again.
Two Still Open
Meanwhile, the gambling estab-
lishments at Farren's and the
Eventail night club remained
open last night, despite orders
issued by Mr. Pan Dah, commis-
sioner of the Western Area
Special Police Force, for the
closing of all gambling dens in
areas under his control by the
end of May.
The two dens were the only
ones that defied orders of the
police chief, it will be noted. On
June 3, Mr. Pan declared to the
Evening Post that he would see
to the closing of the gambling
establishments within 48 hours.

Difficult Task

In an interview with the Even-
ing Post this morning, Mr. Pan
declared that although the two
dens failed to close down last
night, he did not expect them to
remain long in business. Mr. Pan
indicated that immense difficulties
were confronting him in the
closing of the two dens.
Three of the five major dens,
the Chateau International
the China Club, and the Union
Club, were closed on May 31, it
will be recalled.

1941年6月

采取行动终结法伦氏（Farren's）
及扇形夜总会（Eventail）的赌博活动

西区特别警察部队总监潘达（Pan Dah）先生透露，关闭西区赌馆行动的第一阶段已经完成，他宣布，下一步关闭由外国人经营的场所的行动正在进行中，预计在未来几天内见效。据悉，上海特别市市长陈公博已向上海领事团提出正式请求，敦促外国领事代表遏制仍由享有治外法权的外国人在“越界筑路”地区运营的赌馆。

一家由上周被当局关闭的中方赌馆赞助的联合赌博企业曾在德尔蒙特（Del Monte's）设立，但仅营业了一天。今早有人看到该场所的一些新建工程正在拆除，人们相信该赌窝不会再次开业。

两家仍然开放

与此同时，尽管西区特别警察部队总监潘达先生已下令在5月底前关闭其管辖区域内的所有赌馆，但法伦氏（Farren's）和扇形（Eventail）夜总会的赌博场所昨晚仍然开放。

值得注意的是，这两家赌窝是唯一违抗警察局长命令的场所。6月3日，潘先生向《晚报》（Evening Post）表示，他将在48小时内确保这些赌博场所关闭。

艰巨任务

在今早接受《晚报》采访时，潘先生表示，虽然这两家赌窝昨晚未能关闭，但他预计它们不会长期营业。潘先生指出，他在关闭这两家赌窝时面临着巨大的困难。

回想起来，五大主要赌馆中的三家——国际大酒店（Chateau International）、中国俱乐部（China Club）和联合俱乐部（Union Club）——已于5月31日关闭。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS
June 6 1947

Police Chief Declares
Gambling Ended

Mayor Chen Kung-po, of the
Greater Shanghai Special Municipal
Government forwarded an official
letter on Wednesday to the Senior
Consul of the Consular Body in
Shanghai asking the latter to request
foreign authorities concerned to co-
operate with Chinese authorities in
closing foreign-managed gambling
houses in the Western District, it was
learned from official Chinese quart-
ers yesterday. All Chinese-owned
gambling houses in the same district,
including the biggest ones, were re-
cently ordered closed by local Chi-
nese authorities.
No details of the Mayor's letter
were disclosed but it was learned
that it explained that the establish-
ment of gambling houses in the dis-
trict by foreign interests was con-
trary to the agreement signed be-
tween the Shanghai Municipal Council
and the Chinese city regime prior to
the formation of the Western District
Special Police Bureau.
Mr. C. C. Pan, Commissioner of the
special police recently declared that
he would see to that that there would
be no revival of gambling activities
in his district following the closure
of Chinese gambling houses. He
made the statement following rum-
ours that the biggest gambling house
in Avenue Haig would reopen under
a foreign name, forming a syndicate
with six other gambling houses al-
ready closed.

《华北每日新闻》
1947年6月6日

警察局长宣布
赌博已终结

据中方官方人士昨日获悉，大上海特别市政府市长陈公博于周三向上海领事团首席领事发送了一封公函，请后者要求有关外国当局与中国当局合作，关闭西区由外国人管理的赌馆。同一区域内所有华人拥有的赌馆，包括最大的几家，最近已被中国地方当局下令关闭。

市长信函的细节未予披露，但据悉信中解释称，外国势力在该区设立赌馆违反了西区特别警察局成立之前上海公共租界工部局与中国市政当局签署的协议。

特别警察总监潘CC先生（Mr. C. C. Pan）最近宣称，在华资赌馆关闭后，他将确保其辖区内不再有赌博活动死灰复燃。此前有谣言称，海格路（Avenue Haig）最大的赌馆将以外国名义重新开业，并与另外六家已关闭的赌馆组成辛迪加。

Gambling dens in the Western District
--------------------------------------

The "East Asia Club" (東亞俱樂部), a
small gambling den located at House 79 Yah Sze Loong,
off Ferry Road, which recently came into existence,
was closed on June 20 in view of possible action by
the Western Shanghai Area Special Police Authorities.

The East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032,
25 Yu Yuen Road, previously in charge of supervision
of gaming establishments in the Western District, has
ceased functioning, subsequent to the recent closure
of the gambling dens in the extra-Settlement roads
area.

According to information obtained, endeavours
are being made by "guards" of the defunct gambling dens
in the Western District to resume gaming activities in
co-operation with their former employers. They
attempted to use the premises of the "Argentina" club,
626 Avenue Haig, but their efforts are said to have
been temporarily frustrated in view of firm attitude
on the part of Mayor Chen Kung Poh.

C O N F I D E N T I A L

June 3, 1941.

GAMBLING DENS IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT - SITUATION.

The "Chiu Lung" Hotel, a new establishment at
452 Avenue Haig, did not open on June 2, in consequence
of an order from the Western District Japanese Military
Police. This hotel was prepared to commence operations
at 3 p.m. June 2, when verbal instructions were received
from Major Tsukimoto ( ) of the Western District
Japanese Gendarme ordering it to refrain from functioning.

The decision against the "Chiu Lung" Hotel is re-
ported to have been adopted by the Japanese Authorities
ostensibly due to a complaint made by the Deutscher Gar-
ten Klub, 454 Avenue Haig, through the medium of the
German Consulate, but the financial problem is believed
to be the real cause for the action. It is stated that
according to previous negotiations, the new establishment
was permitted to open on condition that it pay the various
fees hitherto borne by the defunct three gambling dens,
namely, the Loh Kuo Hotel, China Club and Union Club. How-
ever, the "Chiu Lung" Hotel is said to have agreed to pay
only half of the sums previously paid by the three dens.

Endeavours are now being made by the Management
of the "Chiu Lung" Hotel to reach an understanding with
the Japanese Authorities for its establishment.

Following closure, the employees of the China Club,
29 Tifeng Road and the Union Club, 6 Tifeng Road, have been
paid off. The China Club employees were paid $80:00 each,
whilst those in the employ of the Union Club were paid $40:00
each.

机 密

1941年6月3日。

西区赌馆 - 情况。

位于海格路（Avenue Haig）452号的新设场所“九龙”酒店（"Chiu Lung" Hotel），因西区日本宪兵队的命令，未于6月2日开业。该酒店原准备于6月2日下午3时开始营业，此时接到西区日本宪兵队队长塚本少校（Major Tsukimoto）（原文不清）的口头指示，命令其不得营业。

据报道，日本当局对“九龙”酒店作出的决定，表面上是因为德国花园俱乐部（Deutscher Garten Klub，海格路454号）通过德国领事馆提出投诉，但财务问题被认为是采取此举的真正原因。据称，根据之前的谈判，新场所获准开业的条件是支付此前由三家已倒闭赌馆承担的各种费用，即罗国酒店（Loh Kuo Hotel）、中国俱乐部（China Club）和联合俱乐部（Union Club）。然而，据说“九龙”酒店仅同意支付这三家赌馆此前支付金额的一半。

目前，“九龙”酒店的管理层正努力与日本当局就其开业事宜达成谅解。

关闭后，位于提丰路（Tifeng Road）29号的中国俱乐部和提丰路6号的联合俱乐部的员工已被解雇并结清工资。中国俱乐部的员工每人获得80.00美元，而联合俱乐部的员工每人获得40.00美元。

The decision against the "Chiu Lung" Hotel
is reported to have been adopted by the Japanese
Authorities ostensibly due to a complaint made by the
Deutscher Garten Klub, 454 Avenue Haig, through
the medium of the German Consulate, but the financial
problem is believed to be the real cause for the
action. It is stated that according to previous
negotiations, the new establishment was permitted
to open on condition that it pay the various fees
hitherto borne by the defunct three gambling dens,
namely, the Loh Kuo Hotel, China Club and Union Club.
However, the "Chiu Lung" Hotel is said to have agreed
to pay only half of the sum previously paid by the
three dens.

Endeavours are now being made by the management
of the "Chiu Lung" Hotel to reach an understanding
with the Japanese Authorities for its establishment.

Following closure, the employees of the China
Club, 29 Tifeng Road and the Union Club, 6 Tifeng Road
have been paid off. The China Club employees were
paid $60.00 each, whilst those in the employ of the Union
Club were paid $40.00 each.

西区赌馆 - 情况

位于海格路（Avenue Haig）452号的新设场所“九龙”酒店，因西区日本宪兵队的命令，未于6月2日开业。该酒店原准备于6月2日下午3时开始营业，此时接到西区日本宪兵队藤野少校（Major Fujino）（批注：Fujino 藤野）（ 藤 野 ）的口头指示，命令其不得营业。

据报道，日本当局对“九龙”酒店作出的决定，表面上是因为德国花园俱乐部（Deutscher Garten Klub，海格路454号）通过德国领事馆提出投诉，但财务问题被认为是采取此举的真正原因。据称，根据之前的谈判，新场所获准开业的条件是支付此前由三家已倒闭赌馆承担的各种费用，即罗国酒店（Loh Kuo Hotel）、中国俱乐部（China Club）和联合俱乐部（Union Club）。然而，据说“九龙”酒店仅同意支付这三家赌馆此前支付金额的一半。

目前，“九龙”酒店的管理层正努力与日本当局就其开业事宜达成谅解。

关闭后，位于提丰路（Tifeng Road）29号的中国俱乐部和提丰路6号的联合俱乐部的员工已被解雇并结清工资。中国俱乐部的员工每人获得60.00美元，而联合俱乐部的员工每人获得40.00美元。

June 3, 1941

Japanese Gendarmes in plain clothes had entered the
premises and inspected the grounds with the result that
the gambling did not start as expected.

Gambling dens in the Western District - Situation.
------------------

According to information obtained, the three
gambling dens now operating in the Western District,
O.O.L., will amalgamate into one establishment and will
function in the form of a club. The amalgamation is
reported to take place in the near future, possibly at
the end of May or the beginning of June, 1941.

It is stated that LEE SHIH CHUN (李士群),
Minister of Police of the Nanking Government, has
instructed the gambling den conductors through the
medium of WOO SZE PAO (吳士寶), to make necessary
preparations for the amalgamation and to operate the
club at a new venue. However, there is a likelihood
that the premises of the Loh Kuo Hotel, a gambling den
at 346 Avenue Haig will be used as the site of the new
club, if no other suitable premises can be found.

It will be remembered that the three gambling
dens were ordered by Mayor Chen Kung Poh to close down
during the middle of the current month, but they continue
functioning through the efforts of WOO SZE PAO. The
Mayor has insisted on the suppression of the gambling
dens in the Western District as a step towards the
elimination of evils in that area apart from upholding
his prestige. He is said to have appealed to Mr. WANG
CHING WEI in this connection. However, LEE SHIH CHUN
was of the opinion that the immediate closing down of
those gambling dens in the extra-Settlement roads area
will affect the "livelihood" of the members of the
Special Service Group as far as the financial problem
is concerned. The Minister of Police is reported to

需指出的是，这三家赌场曾被市长陈公博命令于本月中旬关闭，但在吴世宝的努力下，它们继续运营。市长坚持取缔西区赌场，以此作为消除该地区弊端的步骤，同时也为了维护其威望。据说他已就此事项向汪精卫 (WANG CHING WEI) 先生提出呼吁。然而，李士群认为，立即关闭越界筑路区域的这些赌场，将在财务问题上影响特别服务组 (Special Service Group) 成员的“生计”。据报道，警政部长

SECRET May 11, 1941.

Gambling Dens in the Western District - Situation.

According to information obtained, the gambling
dens in the Western District have received verbal
instructions from Mr. Pan Dah, Commissioner of the
Western Shanghai Area Special Police Force, ordering
them to cease functioning by the middle of this month.
This decision is known to have been made by Mayor Chen
Kung Poh as a step towards the elimination of evils in
the Western District.

It is learned, however, that endeavours are being
made by conductors of the gambling dens concerned, with
the assistance of Woo Sze Pao, in charge of the Special
Service Group attached to the Shanghai Office of the
Ministry of Police, 76 Jessfield Road, to negotiate with
the Japanese and City Government authorities in the
hope of maintaining existence of their establishments.

There are three leading gambling dens operating
in the extra-Settlement roads area, namely.

(1) Loh Kuo Hotel          348 Avenue Haig.
(2) China Club             29 Tifeng Road.
(3) Union Club             6 Tifeng Road.

CONFIDENTIAL

April 8, 1941.

Gambling dens in the Western District - Situation.

In dealing with the suppression of gambling
dens now operating in the Western District, O.O.L.,
negotiations are said to be in progress between the
City Government and Japanese Authorities with a view
to reach an understanding. Conductors of the
gaming establishments in the extra-Settlement roads
area, however, continue their efforts to seek
connivance of the Chinese and Japanese authorities
to maintain operations. They are of the opinion
that for the sake of upholding the prestige of
Mayor Chen Kung Poh, one of the leading dens -
the Hwa Loh Hotel, 792 Yu Yuen Road - has been
closed. So far nothing concrete has yet been
reached in the negotiations.

April 4, 1941.

Gambling dens in the Western District - Situation

The following three gambling dens continue
to operate in the Western District, S.O.L.
(1) Loh Kuo Hotel        346 Avenue Haig.
(2) China Club           29 Tifeng Road.
(3) Union Club            6 Tifeng Road.
The signboards of the three dens, however, have been
removed as a result of an understanding reached
between the conductors and the Western District
authorities. It is learned that these three gaming
establishments pay a total sum of $1,000,000.00 per
month to the Western Shanghai Area Special Police
Force.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 5 APR 1941）

At 5.05 p.m., April 3, a canister bomb was
found in a room of the China Club, 29 Tifeng Road.
It was discovered by a guard named Zung Dao (陳濤)
who reported the matter to the management of the den.
Whilst being removed, the bomb exploded causing injury
to the guard. The victim is now receiving treatment
in the Red Cross Hospital, Avenue Haig.

L.C.(C.v S.B.)
Commr of Pol.
Sir:
Information
J. Sharman

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 80299/41(C)O
Date

4th April 41.

Special Branch Report No. 1

'Bomb explosion at The China Club, No.29
Tifeng Road.'

At 5.10 p.m. 3/4/41, a telephone message was
received at the 2nd Division, 15 Jessfield Road, reporting
that a bomb had exploded and injured one of the employees.

C.I.Blenkinsop, Officer i/c 2nd Division attended
and learned that, at 5.05 p.m. 3/4/41, a cigarette type
bomb was found in the main gambling room by a guard named
Sheng Shing (陳清) age 36, Kompo, who picked it up
with the intention of placing it in a bucket of water.

However, it exploded when picked up, and injured
him on both hands.

He was taken to the Red Cross Hospital, 363 Avenue
Haig, where he was treated for 'Multiple' shell wounds of
both hands' and allowed to go.

No information could be obtained regarding the
person or persons who placed the bomb in the room, and
no bomb fragments could be found.

Crime Branch informed and conducting enquiries.

Mr. Clissold, D.C. informed.

1941年4月4日。

特别股报告第1号

‘提丰路29号华人总会炸弹爆炸案。’

1941年4月3日下午5时10分，杰斯菲尔德路15号第二分区接到电话报告，称发生炸弹爆炸并致一名雇员受伤。

第二分区主管 C.I. Blenkinsop 警官到场调查，获悉1941年4月3日下午5时05分，一名名叫盛兴 (Sheng Shing) [注：原文拼音为Sheng Shing，括号内中文为陳清，此处依原文翻译并保留括号内容]、36岁、籍贯金波 (Kompo) [音译] 的警卫在主赌博室发现一枚香烟型炸弹，他捡起炸弹意图将其放入一桶水中。

然而，炸弹在捡起时爆炸，导致其双手受伤。

他被送往海格路363号红十字会医院，因“双手多处弹片伤”接受治疗后被允许离开。

未能获得关于放置炸弹者的任何信息，也未找到炸弹碎片。

已通知刑事侦缉处并进行调查。

已通知副督察长 Clissold 先生。

SECRET
March 15, 1941.

Gambling dens and opium hongs in the Western District

Despite verbal instructions recently given by the
Shanghai City Government to the effect that all gambling
dens operating in the Western Area, O.O.L. would have to
close, the following four large gambling dens continue to
operate :

1. Loh Kuo Hotel          346 Avenue Haig
2. China Club             29 Tifeng Road
3. Hwa Loh Hotel          798 Yu Yuen Road
4. Union Club             6 Tifeng Road.

（批：Commissioner of Police,
S.I.
Information
J. Sharman
A.C. (Sp. Br.)）

According to information received, conductors
of these four gambling dens have reached an understanding
with Woo Sze Pao (吴世保), Chief of the Defence Corps
and the Special Service Group Headquarters, 76 Jesefield
Road, and the Japanese Military Police, whereby the latter
would support the conductors against any action adopted by
the City Government Authorities. Woo is said to have
told Col. Loo Ying, Commissioner of the City Government
Police, of the attitude of the gambling dens conductors,
and urged the former to impress upon Mayor Chen Kung Poh
that any drastic attempts on the part of the City
Government to close the dens may result in unpleasant conse-
quences. It is reported that with the support of Woo Sze
Pao and the Japanese Military Police, the conductors of the
gambling dens are prepared to offer armed resistance if a
forcible attempt by the City Government authorities is
made to close them. To meet any emergency a number of
firearms have been stored in readiness at the China Club,
29 Tifeng Road.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CRIME AND SPECIAL BRANCH
15 MAR 1941）

（印：FILE）

However, with a view to reaching an amicable settle-
ment the conductors have appealed to the City Government
page_data.zh:
机密
1941年3月15日。

西区赌场与鸦片烟馆

尽管上海市政府最近口头指示，所有在越界筑路区（O.O.L.）西区运营的赌场必须关闭，但以下四家大型赌场仍在运营：

1. 六国饭店          海格路346号
2. 华人俱乐部         提丰路29号
3. 华乐饭店          愚园路798号
4. 联合俱乐部         提丰路6号。

（批注：警务处处长，
特别情报处。
信息
J. Sharman
助理处长（特别分部））

据收到的消息，这四家赌场的经营者已与吴世保（Woo Sze Pao，音译）达成谅解，吴系杰斯菲尔德路76号保卫团及特别服务组总部主任，并与日本宪兵队达成协议，由后者支持经营者对抗市政府当局采取的任何行动。据说吴已向上海市政府警察局局长陆英（Loo Ying，音译）上校通报了赌场经营者的态度，并敦促前者向市长陈公博强调，如果市政府试图强行关闭这些赌场，可能会导致不愉快的后果。据报道，在吴世保和日本宪兵队的支持下，如果市政府当局试图强行关闭赌场，赌场经营者准备进行武装抵抗。为了应对紧急情况，中国俱乐部（China Club），提丰路29号，已储存了一批枪支以备不时之需。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
罪案与特别分部
1941年3月15日）

（印章：档案）

然而，为了达成和解，经营者已向市政府

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Authorities. It is stated that the former agreed to
close their establishments for a short period provided
that they be allowed to reopen them after the new Police
Force is established in the Western Area. For permission
to continue operations the conductors have suggested to
pay a large sum of money to the Shanghai City Government.
Both suggestions Mayor Chen Kung Poh disapproved of and
said that he intended to bring about the closing of the
gambling dens which operated in the area under his control.
Further information to hand is to the effect that
the conductors of the four gambling dens now operating have
each agreed to raise the daily "protection fees" from
$12,000.00 to $15,000.00. This protection fee is paid to
the East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032 , 25 Yu Yuen
Road, of which Mr. Yamaki is in charge. This decision was
made with a view to furthering the support given by the
Japanese authorities.

---

There are 42 opium hongs in the Western District, C.O.L.
They have rented houses in Nantao preparatory for removal
if instructed to remove by the City Government. They are,
however, making efforts to secure permission from the Japanese
and City Government authorities to continue business at their
present addresses.

-----
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

当局提出上诉。据说，前者同意暂时关闭其场所，条件是在西区建立新的警察部队后允许其重新开业。为了获得继续经营的许可，经营者建议向上海市政府支付一大笔款项。陈公博市长驳回了这两项建议，并表示他打算关闭在其管辖区域内运营的赌场。进一步的消息称，目前运营的四家赌场的经营者已同意将每日“保护费”从12,000.00美元提高到15,000.00美元。这笔保护费支付给位于愚园路25号1032弄的东亚慈善协会，该协会由山木先生（Mr. Yamaki，音译）负责。做出这一决定是为了进一步争取日本当局的支持。

---

在越界筑路区（C.O.L.）西区有42家鸦片烟馆。他们已在南市租赁房屋，以备在市政府下令搬迁时迁移。然而，他们正在努力从日本和市政府当局那里获得许可，以便在现址继续营业。

-----

page_data.en:
803919/41(C)-O
March 10, 1941.

Gambling dens in the Western District - situation

The Shanghai City Government recently notified
the gambling dens operating in the Western District
to cease functioning. The Police Bureau was instructed
by Mayor Chen Kung Poh to take action against those
dens in the event of their refusing to obey the order.
According to information received, it was proposed that
on the evening of March 7 to have the reserve unit of
the City Government Police raid the gambling establishments.
The conductors of the gambling dens appealed
to the Japanese Military Police. The Japanese Gendarmerie,
it is reported, decided against the proposal of the
City Government Police to close down the gambling
establishments. As a result, the City Government did
not proceed with the proposition.

The following four large gaming establishments
are still operating at the following places :

1. Loh Kuo Hotel          346 Avenue Haig.
2. China Club             29 Tifeng Road.
3. Hwa Loh Hotel          792 Yu Yuen Road.
4. Union Club             6 Tifeng Road.
page_data.zh:
803919/41(C)-O
1941年3月10日。

西区赌场 - 局势

上海市政府最近通知在西区运营的赌场停止运作。陈公博市长指示警察局在赌场拒绝服从命令的情况下采取行动。据收到的消息，原计划于3月7日晚由市政府警察后备队突袭这些赌博场所。赌场经营者向日本宪兵队求助。据报道，日本宪兵队决定反对市政府警察局关闭赌博场所的提议。因此，市政府未执行该计划。

以下四家大型赌博场所仍在以下地点运营：

1. 六国饭店          海格路346号。
2. 华人俱乐部         提丰路29号。
3. 华乐饭店          愚园路792号。
4. 联合俱乐部         提丰路6号。

page_data.en:

Cheng Yien Pao :-
THE GAMBLING DENS IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT
On the afternoon of March 7 the Loh Kuo
(六國), the China Club (華人俱樂部), the Hwa Loh (華樂)
and other gambling dens and several scores of opium dens
received telephone messages from a certain party to the
effect that preparations be made by the managements and
that as soon as formal instructions were given, the dens
be closed immediately.
It is not known as to whether they will
be allowed to move to Nantao after they have closed down
in the Western District.

February 24, 1941.

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following report:-

REPORTED POSTPONEMENT OF SUPPRESSION OF LEADING
GAMBLING DENS IN WESTERN DISTRICT

Recently reports have been current to the
effect that all big gambling dens in the Western District
will close down prior to the inauguration of the Special
Police Force.

According to well-informed circles, three
or four big gambling dens are continuing to operate despite
the fact that several small gaming houses have already closed
their doors.

It is also learned that these gambling dens
have postponed the date of their formal closure till August
so that the several thousand employees of these gambling dens
may have sufficient time to find employment.
page_data.zh:
1941年2月24日。

《中美日报》刊登如下报道：-

据报道西区主要赌窟取缔行动延期

近期有传闻称，在特别警察部队成立之前，西区所有大型赌窟都将关闭。

据消息灵通人士称，尽管数家小型赌场已经关门，但仍有三四家大型赌窟继续营业。

另获悉，这些赌窟已将正式关闭日期推迟至八月，以便这几千名赌窟雇员有足够时间寻找工作。

Central China Daily News, Kuo Min Daily News, New China Daily
News and Ping Pao :-

HAND GRENADE THROWN AT THE LIEN CHIAO CLUB

At about 10.10 p.m. yesterday, a hand
grenade was thrown outside the Lien Chiao Club (聯僑總會),
at No. 6 Tifeng Road, but no one was injured by the
explosion. There were bodyguards posted outside the Club.
When the gamblers heard the explosion, they all tried to
run away.
A search was later made by policemen and
detectives, but the men responsible for the throwing of the
hand grenade had already disappeared. Some bomb fragments
were picked up.

Central China Daily News and New China Daily News :-

SNATCHING AT THE CHINA CLUB

As the gamblers were playing in a
downstairs room of the China Club (華人總會) on Tifeng
Road yesterday evening, several tens of unarmed men entered
and snatched away all the articles and money on the tables
and made good their escape. The bodyguards attempted to
stop them, but failed. Order was restored 15 minutes
later.
Another report states that several
suspects were arrested by policemen.

报道西区主要赌窟取缔行动延期

近日流传消息称，在特别警察部队成立之前，西区所有大型赌窟都将关闭。
据消息灵通人士称，尽管几家小型赌场已经关门，但仍有三到四家大型赌窟继续营业。
另据悉，这些赌窟已将正式关闭日期推迟至八月，以便这几千名赌窟雇员有足够时间寻找工作。

《华中日报》、《国民日报》、《新华日报》及《平报》：

手榴弹袭击联侨总会

昨晚约10时10分，一枚手榴弹被投掷在提封路6号联侨总会（聯僑總會）外，爆炸未造成人员受伤。总会外设有保镖。赌徒们听到爆炸声后，纷纷试图逃跑。
随后警察和侦探进行了搜查，但投掷手榴弹的肇事者已逃离现场。现场拾获了一些炸弹碎片。

《华中日报》及《新华日报》：

华人总会发生抢劫案

昨晚，当赌徒们在提封路华人总会（華人總會）楼下房间赌博时，数十名未持武器的男子闯入，抢走了桌上的所有财物和现金后逃逸。保镖试图阻止但未成功。十五分钟后秩序恢复。
另有报道称，几名嫌疑人已被警察逮捕。

page_data.en:
February 24, 1941. Morning Translation.

Cheng Yien Pao :-

IMPRESSMENT OF CHINESE ALONG SHANGHAI-HANGCHOW RAILWAY

Impressment of Chinese is taking place in the occupied areas, the so-called "kingly way happyland". Our reporter has secured the following information from a person who was recently impressed but who succeeded in making his escape :-
"Early this month, Japanese soldiers at Changan (长安) and Siashih (石) along the Shanghai-Hangchow Railway suddenly closed all the thoroughfares in the vicinity and carried off 80% to 90% of the young people living in this area and detained them near a mountain north of Kashing. The youths were subsequently sent to the front to fight the guerrillas. Their fate is unknown.
"I was held up at a place along the Shanghai-Hangchow Railway and sent to Shanghai where I was detained in a compound next to the Japanese military headquarters in Yangtsepoo. There were already some 500 people there. On the night of February 14, the Japanese soldiers packed up their belongings. It was said that they were being sent to Hainan Islands. The 500 young men who had been impressed became uneasy. As the guards were somewhat slack at that time, scores of them succeeded in making good their escape. It is said that the people impressed had no food to eat while many were whipped. It is believed that those who could not escape have been sent away and now have little chance to escape."

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao, National Herald :-

According to information secured by the Dah Kwan News Agency, impressment by Japanese soldiers along the Shanghai-Hangchow Railway is proceeding.
Certain arrivals in Shanghai yesterday said that the Japanese soldiers started to impress Chinese along the Shanghai-Hangchow Railway on February 16 and since then some 1,000 able-bodied men have been carried off. Of this number, some 400 people were conscripted at Siashih. All the shops in this town suspended business for people were afraid to go out. Normal conditions in this town were restored after five days. People seized at Changan, Kashing, Haining, Kashan and other places were placed on trains which carried them off in a northerly direction.

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, National Herald (23/2) :-

COMPASSIONATE GRANT TO ASSASSINATED REPORTER OF "SHUN PAO"

The Chungking Government regrets the assassination by traitorous elements of King Hwa-ting (金華亭), a reporter of the "Shun Pao" in Shanghai.
At a meeting held recently, the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang at Chungking resolved that a compassionate grant of $20,000 be issued to the family of the deceased.
P.T.O.
page_data.zh:
1941年2月24日。晨间译件。

《诚言报》：

沪杭铁路沿线强征华人

在被占领区，即所谓的“王道乐土”，正在发生强征华人的事件。本报记者从一名近期被强征但成功逃脱的人士处获悉以下信息：
“本月早些时候，沪杭铁路沿线的长安（Changan）和石（Siashih）的日军突然封锁了附近的所有通道，掳走了该地区80%至90%的青年，并将他们拘禁在嘉兴（Kashing）北部的一座山附近。这些青年随后被送往前线与游击队作战。他们的命运尚不清楚。
“我在沪杭铁路沿线某地被拦下，并被送往上海，关押在杨树浦日本军事总部旁边的一个院落里。那里当时已有约500人。2月14日晚，日军士兵收拾行装。据说他们将被派往海南岛。这500名被强征的青年人心惶惶。由于当时看守 somewhat 松懈，数十人成功逃脱。据说被强征者没有食物充饥，许多人遭到鞭打。据信，那些未能逃脱的人已被送走，现在几乎没有逃脱的机会。”

《诚言报》、《中美日报》、《申报》、《国民新闻报》：

据大光通讯社获得的消息，日军在沪杭铁路沿线进行的强征行动正在进行中。
昨日抵沪的一些人士称，日军于2月16日开始在沪杭铁路沿线强征华人，此后约有1,000名壮丁被掳走。其中，约有400人是在石（Siashih）被征召的。该镇所有商店均停止营业，因为人们不敢外出。五天后，该镇的正常状况得以恢复。在长安（Changan）、嘉兴（Kashing）、海宁（Haining）、嘉善（Kashan）等地被抓捕的人被装上火车，向北运走。

《诚言报》、《中美日报》、《申报》、《新晚报》、《国民新闻报》（2月23日）：

向《申报》遇刺记者发放抚恤金

重庆政府对《申报》驻上海记者金華亭（King Hwa-ting）遭汉奸分子刺杀表示哀悼。
在近期举行的一次会议上，国民党重庆中央执行委员会决议，向死者家属发放抚恤金20,000元。

February 24, 1941. Afternoon Translation.

We would like to give our sincere advice to
the merchants. It is true that merchants have to make
profit, but there should be a limit to such profit. If they
care only for profit without due regard to the general
situation, they are liable, when the hostilities are over,
to face retribution on account of the atrocious exploitation
of the people in which they are engaged at present, even
though they may be able to escape the law at present. It is
still not too late for one who has gone astray to become
upright again. It is, therefore, hoped that those merchants
who are raising commodity prices to exploit the public will
quickly come to their senses. .

New China Daily News, Bing Pao, Central China Daily News and
Kuo Min Daily News :-

THE SHOOTING OF A CHINESE DOCTOR AND HIS JAPANESE WIFE

Dr. Sung Chien-an (沈健安) and his Japanese
wife, who were both fired at and wounded by robbers at their
home at No. 50, Lane 429, Race Course Road, at about 10 a.m.
February 22, are being treated in the Foo Min hospital on
North Szechuen Road.
Sung's wife is in a serious condition because
the bullet struck her in the right breast and is lodged in
the abdomen. She was operated upon yesterday afternoon.
The doctor's wound is not serious.

Shun Pao and Sin Wan Pao (advertisement) :-

Notice by Dr. Sung Chien-An of Chien An Hospital

The following notice is published by Dr. Sung
Chien-an:-
"I have never participated in political
activities. It is unfortunate that I have been slightly
wounded in a robbery case. I will resume business from
February 25.
"Lest people should labour under some
misunderstanding, this notice is published for general
information."

Cheng Yien Pao of February 23 :-

THE PAWNSHOPS IN NANTAO AND THE WESTERN DISTRICT

There are some 100 so-called pawnshops in
Nantao and the Western District.
Yesterday morning, several mercenary policemen
were detailed by the Police Bureau in the Western District
to order a section of these so-called pawnshops to suspend
business immediately.
It is learned that most of them are small
shops, but the larger ones will be allowed to continue their
business because they have completed arrangements with the
authorities concerned.
page_data.zh:
1941年2月24日。下午译文。

我们谨向商界人士提出诚恳劝告。商人谋利固然属实，但利润应有限度。若只顾牟利而不顾大局，即便眼下能逃脱法律制裁，待战事结束后，亦必将因目前从事的残酷剥削民众行为而面临报应。迷途知返，为时未晚。因此，希望那些抬高物价、剥削公众的商人尽快醒悟。

《新华日报》、《平报》、《华中日报》及《国民日报》：

一名中国医生及其日本妻子遭枪击

沈健安医生（Dr. Sung Chien-an）及其日本妻子于2月22日上午10时许，在跑马厅路429弄50号寓所内遭匪徒开枪射击受伤，目前正在北四川路福民医院接受治疗。
沈妻伤势严重，子弹击中其右胸并滞留于腹部。她已于昨日下午接受手术。
该医生伤势不重。

《申报》及《新闻报》（广告）：

健安医院沈健安医生启事

沈健安医生发布如下启事：
“本人从未参与政治活动。不幸在抢劫案中受轻伤。本人将于2月25日起恢复营业。
为避免公众产生误解，特此登报周知。”

2月23日《正言报》：

南市及西区当铺

南市及西区有所谓当铺约一百家。
昨晨，西区警察局派遣数名警员，命令其中一部分所谓当铺立即停业。
据悉，这些当铺大多为小店铺，但规模较大的当铺因已与有关当局办妥手续，获准继续营业。

page_data.en:
February 24, 1941. Afternoon Translation.

New China Daily News :-

NOTORIOUS H'LO H'EI LOTTERY CHARACTER MISSING

According to information secured by the Hwa
Kwang News Agency, Yoh Shih-sen (郁仕生), residing at a
certain place in the Western District, who is as notorious
in Hwo Hwei Lottery circles as Li Siao-pao (李小包) or
Mou Ah-ziang (某阿祥), has not been seen since he left
home three days ago.
Strenuous efforts are being made by his
family to locate him. No report has been made to the Police.

Central China Daily News and Chung Kuo Shang Pao :-

NUMBER OF UNEMPLOYED IN SHANGHAI RAPIDLY INCREASING

Due to the European War and the obstruction
of transportation, industry in Shanghai has been seriously
affected and in order to curtail expenses, many factories
have discharged some of their workers.
It is learned that owing to the difficulty
of finding work even at low wages, workers in the interior
districts are coming to Shanghai to find work. As a result,
the number of unemployed in Shanghai is rapidly increasing.

Chinese-American Daily News (comment) :-

MERCHANTS SHOULD COME TO THEIR SENSES

Yesterday we published an article asking the
authorities of the Foreign Settlements to adopt strict
sanctions against the unreasonable increasing of commodity
prices so that the prestige of the authorities can be
maintained and the burdens of the people can be alleviated.
To-day we would like to submit the following
views for consideration by merchants in Shanghai:-
China is now engaged in a hard and difficult
struggle. At this critical stage, we all should be firm
and do our utmost for victory. Any one who thinks that he
can utilize the present opportunity to do things detrimental
to others but beneficial to himself is unworthy of his
country.
Ever since Shanghai became an isolated city,
the influence of the Government has diminished with the
result that great changes have taken place in the city.
The residents, however, have remained firm and have
encouraged one another with examples of loyalty. They are
leading an upright life in the face of many hardships; they
are looking for the advent of a brighter day and are
therefore willing to go through a period of darkness for
the time being. Unfortunately, a small section of local
merchants, disregarding the welfare of the general public,
have frequently made use of their influence and wealth to
hoard commodities and to manipulate the prices of goods with
the result that the poor people, who constitute a majority
in the local population, have been made to face increased
burdens and hardships.

P.T.O.
page_data.zh:
1941年2月24日。下午译件。

《新中国日报》：

臭名昭著之“华威”彩票人物失踪

据华光通讯社获悉，居住于西区某地的郁仕生（Yoh Shih-sen），其在“华威”（Hwo Hwei）彩票圈内之恶名，不亚于李小包（Li Siao-pao）或某阿祥（Mou Ah-ziang），自三日前离家后便下落不明。
其家属正竭力寻找其下落。尚未向警方报案。

《华中日报》及《中国商报》：

上海失业人数急剧增加

受欧洲战争及交通受阻影响，上海工业遭受严重打击，许多工厂为缩减开支，已解雇部分工人。
据悉，由于即便低薪也难觅工作，内地劳工纷纷来沪求职。因此，上海失业人数正迅速增加。

《中美日报》（评论）：

商人应幡然醒悟

昨日本刊发表文章，呼吁租界当局对不合理上涨的物价采取严厉制裁措施，以维护当局威信并减轻民众负担。
今日，我们愿提出以下观点，供上海商人斟酌：
中国正处于艰苦卓绝的斗争之中。在此危急关头，我辈皆应立场坚定，为争取胜利竭尽全力。任何企图利用当前时机损人利己者，均不配称为国人。
自上海成为孤岛以来，政府影响力减弱，导致本市发生巨大变化。然而，市民依然坚定，并以忠诚榜样相互激励。他们在诸多艰难困苦中过着正直的生活，期盼光明日的到来，因此愿意暂时忍受这段黑暗时期。不幸的是，本地少数商人不顾公众福祉，频繁利用其势力与财富囤积商品、操纵物价，致使占本地人口大多数的贫苦百姓面临日益沉重的负担与苦难。

P.T.O.

February 24, 1941.
26 2 41

Union Club - bomb explosion

At 10.10 p.m. February 23, a canister bomb
exploded at the entrance of the Union Club, a
gambling den located at 6 Tifeng Road, O.O.L. No
persons were injured and no arrests reported.

Discreet enquiries revealed that several
days ago the management of the Club received through
the post an annonymous letter which was purported to
have been sent by the "Kwangtung Woo Hu Tang"
(廣東五虎堂), demanding the payment of a
monthly "allowance" of $5,000.00, an answer was
requested through the medium of local newspapers.
This demand, however, was ignored by the management
of the gambling den.

The so-called "Kwangtung Woo Hu Tang" has
not previously come to the notice of the Police.

1941年2月24日。
26 2 41

联合俱乐部 - 炸弹爆炸

2月23日晚10时10分，一枚罐状炸弹在位于西藏路6号的联合俱乐部入口处爆炸，该处系一赌博窝点。无人受伤，亦无逮捕报告。

经秘密查访获悉，数日前，该俱乐部管理层通过邮政收到一封匿名信，声称由“广东五虎堂”寄出，要求每月支付5,000.00美元的“保护费”，并要求通过本地报纸予以回复。然而，该赌博窝点的管理层对此要求未予理睬。

警方此前未曾注意到所谓“广东五虎堂”的活动。

February 19, 1941.

Assassination of Loo Ting in the French Concession

At 9 a.m. February 18, 1941, Loo Ting (盧鼎),
conductor of the Hwa Loh Club, a gambling den at
792 Yu Yuen Road, was fatally shot by a male Chinese,
named Voong Dze Tuh (馮樹德) on Route des Soeurs,
French Concession, as he was leaving his home, House 6
Tuh Foong Li (德豐里), Route Vallon. Loo was
formerly a journalist employed with the Dah Kung Pao
and later a partner of the now defunct Li Wai Lo
Amusement Club at 1238 Yu Yuen Road.

He received two bullet wounds, one in the
buttock and the other in the body. He died instantly.

It is of interest to note that a previous
attempt was made on Loo Ting's life on November 21,
1940 at the Dah San Shing Restaurant, 679 Foochow
Road at his marriage ceremony.

Loo Ting's assassination is said to be an act
of vengeance and has no political significance. The
assailant was shot and wounded by the French Police and
is now detained in St. Marie's Hospital undergoing
medical treatment. Two pedestrians also received
gun-shot wounds during the affray.

（页边批注：See also
N 493）

1941年2月19日。

法租界卢鼎遇刺案

1941年2月18日上午9时，位于愚园路792号的赌场“华乐俱乐部”的经理卢鼎（Loo Ting），在离开其位于法租界瓦隆路（Route Vallon）德丰里6号的住所时，于修女路（Route des Soeurs）被一名名为冯树德（Voong Dze Tuh）的中国男子枪击身亡。卢鼎曾任《大公报》记者，后成为现已停业的愚园路1238号“丽娃罗游乐场”的合伙人。

他身中两弹，一处在臀部，另一处在躯干。他当场死亡。

值得注意的是，此前曾有人于1940年11月21日在福州路679号的大三星酒楼举行的卢鼎婚礼上企图暗杀他。

据悉，卢鼎遇刺系报复行为，并无政治意义。行凶者被法国巡捕开枪击伤，现羁押于圣玛丽医院接受治疗。冲突期间另有两名行人遭枪击受伤。

（页边批注：另见 N 493）

February 19, 1942
Gambling dens in the Western District
- situation

On February 18, all gambling dens operating
in the Western District, O.O.L. closed by order
of the East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032,
25 Yu Yuen Road, with the exception of the
(1) Loh Kuo Hotel          346 Avenue Haig.
(2) China Club             29 Tifeng Road.
(3) Hwa Lah Hotel          792 Yu Yuen Road.
(4) Union Club             6 Tifeng Road.

21 gambling dens were closed.    The promoters
and conductors of these dens are now endeavouring
to obtain permission from the Japanese and City
Government authorities, through the medium of the
East Asia Charity Association, to amalgamate and
open a few large establishments in the same areas.
Their efforts so far have not been successful.
However, it is learned that 626 Avenue Haig, a former
large gambling resort, may reopen in the near future.

1942年2月19日
西区赌场
- 情况

2月18日，根据东亚慈善协会的命令，位于西区、由O.O.L.经营的所有赌场均被关闭，地址为愚园路1032弄，但以下除外：

(2) 中国总会          提封路29号。
(3) 华拉饭店          愚园路792号。
(4) 联合总会          提封路6号。

共关闭了21家赌场。这些赌场的发起人和经营者目前正试图通过东亚慈善协会的中介，从日本当局和上海市政府当局获得许可，以便在同一区域合并并开设几家大型场所。迄今为止，他们的努力尚未成功。然而，据悉，海格路626号这家以前的大型赌博场所可能在不久的将来重新开业。

（批：主席 19/2）

February 19, 1941.

Gambling dens in the Western District - situation.
----------

On February 19, all gambling dens operating
in the Western District, O.C.I. closed by order
of the East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032.
45 Yu Yuan Road, with the exception of the:

(1) Lok Kuo Hotel        348 Avenue Haig.
(2) China Club           39 Tiring Road.
(3) Hwa Lok Hotel        792 Yu Yuan Road.
(4) Union Club           3 Tifeng Road.

21 gambling dens were closed. The promoters
and conductors of these dens are now endeavouring
to obtain permission from the Japanese and City
Government authorities, through the medium of the
East Asia Charity Association, to amalgamate and
open a few large establishments in the same areas.
Their efforts so far have not been successful.
However, it is learned that 348 Avenue Haig, a former
legal gambling resort, may reopen in the near future.

1941年2月19日。

西区赌窟——情况。
---

2月19日，根据东亚慈善协会的命令，位于愚园路1032弄的鸦片缉私处（O.C.I.）关闭了在西区内运营的所有赌窟，但以下场所除外：

(1) 乐国饭店        海格路348号。
(2) 中国总会           提篮桥路39号。
(3) 华乐饭店        愚园路792号。
(4) 联合总会           迪丰路3号。

共有21家赌窟被查封。这些赌窟的组织者和经营者正试图通过东亚慈善协会的渠道，从日本当局和上海市政府当局获得许可，以便在同一区域合并并开设几家大型场所。迄今为止，他们的努力尚未成功。然而，据悉，海格路348号这家前合法赌博场所可能在不久的将来重新开业。

February 11, 1941. Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News and Cheng Yien Pao:-

GAMBLING DENS CURTAILING EXPENSES

According to information from reliable sources, the report that the Special Police Force will be established on March 1 is creating much anxiety among the operators of the gambling dens in the Western District. Past experience has taught them that each time a change takes place, they will again be asked to pay protection fees.

These gambling dens are curtailing expenditure and have abolished several facilities accorded to their patrons. Hereafter there will be no more free meals or transportation facilities because these two items, especially the latter, constitute their principal items of expenditure. The gambling business is also being affected by the trade depression.

February 7, 1941.

Situation in the Western District (gambling dens and
opium hongs).

Gambling dens and opium hongs in the
Western District, O.O.L. are endeavouring to
secure and understanding with the Japanese and
Chinese authorities for the continuance of their
operations after the change has been affected
in the extra-Settlement roads area. A number
are now making preparations for the removal to
Nantao for their establishments in order to
maintain functioning if and when their negotiations
end in failure. As was previously reported, the
gambling dens now operating in the Western District
will be ordered to close in the near future, but
it is possible that a few leading ones will be
allowed to reopen later.

The Hwo Wei Lottery Headquarters were
removed on February 6 from 15 Jessfield Road to
House 12 San Loh Tsung (三樂), Jessfield Road.
The premises at 15 Jessfield Road which were formerly
occupied by the defunct Chow Yuan gambling den,
are being used as the offices of the Shanghai
Branch of the Sino-Japanese Culture Association
(中日文化協會上海分會) which recently came into
existence with headquarters at Nanking. The Branch
in Shanghai is in charge of one Mr. Muira (三浦).

西区局势（赌窟与鸦片行）。

西区（越界筑路区域）的赌窟和鸦片行正努力与日本及中国当局达成谅解，以便在该区域管辖权变更后继续其经营活动。目前，部分经营者正着手将场所迁往南市，以备谈判失败时维持运营。正如先前报告所述，目前在西区运营的赌窟将在近期被勒令关闭，但少数几家主要赌窟日后或许会被允许重新开业。

2月6日，“华威”彩票总部从极司菲尔路15号迁至极司菲尔路三乐里12号。极司菲尔路15号原为已停业的“周元”赌窟所在地，现由中日文化协会上海分会用作办公处；该协会最近成立，总部设于南京。上海分会由三浦（Muira）先生负责。

Shun Dao :- 7/4/51 S.I. Chan has added certain
or confirmations
GAMBLING DENS IN WESTERN DISTRICT PLANNING TO REMOVE
TO NANTAO.

The Western District Police accord which was
signed on February 1 prohibits the existence of all
improper enterprises in the outlying roads area in the
Western District. It is said that all improper
enterprises will be ordered to cease operations when the
Western District Special Police Force has been formed.
The various gambling dens in the Western
District have received notification to this effect from
a certain party and are preparing to remove to other
places in order to carry on their business. The Loh Kuo
Hotel at No. 346 Avenue Haig, the largest gambling den,
has decided to remove to the Small World Amusement Resort
on Foh You Road in Nantao, the buildings of which are
undergoing repairs. The various gambling dens in the
vicinity of Tifeng Road and Yu Yuen Road are also planning
to remove to Nantao and are, therefore, seeking for
suitable premises.
Gambling and opium smoking will become more
rife in Nantao after this. This "Badlands" No. 2
will soon become a cesspool of crime.--- Dah Kwan News
Agency.

P. T. O.

西区赌场计划迁往南市。

2月签署的西区警务协定禁止在西区外围道路区域存在所有不正当行业。据悉，待西区特别警察部队成立后，所有不正当行业将被勒令停业。

西区各赌场已从某方收到此类通知，并正筹备迁往他处以继续经营。海格路346号最大的赌场罗国酒店（Loh Kuo Hotel）已决定迁往南市佛佑路（Foh You Road）的小世界游乐场，该处建筑正在进行修缮。提丰路（Tifeng Road）和豫园路（Yu Yuen Road）附近的各赌场也计划迁往南市，因此正在寻找合适的场所。

此后，南市的赌博和吸食鸦片现象将更为猖獗。这第二块“恶土”（Badlands）很快就会成为犯罪的污秽之地。——达闻通讯社。

February 8, 1941. Morning Translation

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald,
Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao :-

SUPPRESSION OF GAMBLING DENS IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT

It is learned that the authorities of the
International Settlement have approved the appointment of
the Deputy Commissioner of the Special Police Force. Both
parties will exchange lists of staff. No statement has
been issued regarding the closing of gambling dens and other
evil resorts in the Badlands or to the collection of taxes.
It is believed that it will not be difficult to
collect taxes, for the revenue will be used for the expenses
of that district, but it is feared that trouble may arise
over the closing of gambling dens.

《申报》、《新晚报》：

西区取缔赌窟

据悉，公共租界当局已核准任命特别警察部队副总监。双方将交换职员名单。关于关闭“坏地”（Badlands）地区的赌窟及其他罪恶场所，以及征税事宜，迄今未发表任何声明。人们认为，征税应无太大困难，因为所得税款将用于该区的开支；但令人担忧的是，在关闭赌窟问题上可能会引发麻烦。

FEB 1941

West Area
Dens Plan
To Close

Planning To Remove To
Nantao As New Police
Start Functioning

All gambling and opium dens in
the Western District were yester-
day reported to be making pre-
parations to close or remove into
the Nantao area in anticipation of
the formation of the Western area
Special Police Force shortly, when
all extra-policing activities will be
eliminated.

The special political police of the
Nanking regime with headquarters
at 76 Jessfield Road, who have been
operating in the extra-Settlement
area, are expected to conclude their
special activities following estab-
lishment of the new police body,
it is learnt.

The formation of the Special
Police Force will also eliminate the
activities of the police of the
Shanghai Municipal Government
and Japanese gendarmerie in the
Western District.

The question of closing the
gambling and opium dens in the
area to be administered by the new
police force will be discussed be-
tween Mr. C. C. Pan, Commissioner-
elect of the Joint Zone Police Force,
and Superintendent J. B. Clissold,
S.M.C. nominee for the post of De-
puty Commissioner to the new
police body, it was learnt.

First to undertake preparations
for removal was the Luk Kwok
Hotel, reputed to be the largest
gambling den in the "badlands,"
which is understood to have secur-
ed new premises in the Nantao
area.

1941年2月

西区
烟馆与赌窟计划
予以关闭

计划迁往南市，待新警察机构开始运作

据报，西区所有的赌博和鸦片烟馆昨日都在做准备，要么关闭，要么迁往南市地区，以应对即将成立的西区特别警察部队，届时所有法外警务活动都将被取缔。

据悉，总部设在极司菲尔路76号的南京政权特别政治警察一直在租界以外地区活动，预计在新警察机构成立后，其特别行动也将结束。

特别警察部队的成立还将消除上海市政府警察和日本宪兵在西区内的活动。

据悉，关于在新警察部队管辖区域内关闭赌博和鸦片烟馆的问题，将由联合地带警察部队候任总监潘公展先生与工部局提名的新警察机构副总监候选人克利索尔德（J. B. Clissold）警司进行讨论。

首家着手准备搬迁的是鹿苑酒店（Luk Kwok Hotel），该酒店据称是“三不管地带”最大的赌窟，据悉已在南市地区找到了新的经营场所。

Trouble in the Lien Sung Amusement Company, a

Commr. of Police

In the evening of February 4, 1941, at about
9:30 p.m., a fight occurred in the Lien Sung Amusement
Company ( 联生公司 ), 1st house of Lane 259
(Ching Yuin Li 慶云里 ), off Yu Yuen Road, O.O.L.,
between members of the Special Service Group and the
guards of the company. Several shots were exchanged
with the result that a restaurant waiter was wounded
and a number of windows and furniture belonging to the
Company were smashed. Further trouble was cut short
by the arrival of a party of Chinese police led by a
Japanese Gendarme who succeeded in apprehending three
members of the Special Service Group and two of the
guards. The Special Service Group members were later
released while the guards are being detained in the
headquarters of the Japanese Military Police at Western
District, 94 Jessfield Road, O.O.L.

1947

Three Near Death, Many Shot
In Gambling Den Gun Battle

At least three persons are near death and several others were wounded last night when a pitched gun battle occured in a gambling den off Yu Yuen Road at 9.30 p.m.

As the establishment is just half a block beyond the juristiction of the Settlement Police, usual sources of information were unable to confirm the exact cause of the battle.

Ta Tao policemen interviewed at the scene of the trouble said that six of their members in uniform and carrying rifles visited the establishment to "have a little talk" with the manager. After a brief discussion, an argument broke out, and thugs in the employ of the house engaged the police in a major gun duel, the policemen reported.

The thirty gamblers playing at the time stampeded for the door breaking it down as they went, but bullets which filled the air left three of them critically wounded on the floor and wounded an undetermined number of others less seriously.

The police suffered no casualties.

A boy in the employ of the Hungaria Night Club opposite the den was struck in the head by a stray bullet as he crossed the street to investigate the trouble. He was removed to Paulun Hospital by the Fire Brigade Ambulance which was summoned by his employer. The other victims, however, were hustled away to an unknown destination, and their condition could not be learned.

When the place had been emptied, the elaborate den was systematically wrecked. Every window was broken and the gaming tables were smashed into kindling. Four policemen were guarding the wreckage at an early hour this morning. A Russian gambling place on the floor above remained undamaged and in full operation.

What was said in the interview between the police and the owner of the place raided is not known. One source laid the origin of the battle to quarrelling factions of gamblers.

1947年

三人垂危，多人中枪
赌场爆发枪战

昨晚9时30分，在愚园路附近的一家赌场内发生激烈枪战，导致至少三人生命垂危，另有数人受伤。

由于该场所位于租界警务管辖范围之外仅半个街区处，常规消息来源无法确认枪战的确切起因。

在现场接受询问的大道警察局（Ta Tao Police）警员表示，他们六名身着制服、携带步枪的警员前往该场所，旨在与经理“稍作交谈”。据警员报告，简短交谈后发生争执，该场所雇佣的打手与警方展开了大规模枪战。

当时正在赌博的三十名赌客惊慌逃向门口，并在逃离过程中撞坏了大门，但漫天飞舞的子弹导致其中三人重伤倒地，另有数量不明的人员受轻伤。

警方无人伤亡。

一名受雇于赌场对面匈牙利夜总会（Hungaria Night Club）的男孩，在穿过街道查看骚乱情况时，头部被流弹击中。其雇主召来消防队救护车，将其送往宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）。然而，其他受害者被匆忙带往未知地点，其状况无从得知。

待场所清空后，这家布置奢华的赌场遭到系统性破坏。所有窗户均被砸碎，赌桌被拆成木柴。今日凌晨，四名警员在现场看守废墟。楼上的一家俄国人经营的赌场未受损坏，仍在正常营业。

警方与被突袭场所老板之间的谈话内容不详。有消息来源称，枪战起源于赌徒内部派系的争斗。

Four Injured in Gang
War in Badlands

City Government Police
Shot at by Gangsters

Three Chinese were slightly injur-
ed and one was lying fatally wound-
ed at the St. Luke's No. 2 Hospital
following a fight between two rival
gangs at the Lin Seng gambling den,
just behind the Hungaria Restaurant
at 272 Yu Yuen Road.

The fight between the gangs first
started at 8 p.m. yesterday at the
gambling den and involved some
twenty men. During the fight three
men sustained slight injuries, requir-
ing only first aid.

At 9.30 p.m., however, the fight
was resumed and the management of
the gambling den called out the City
Government police. Arriving at the
den, the Chinese policemen were
fired at by one of the gangsters. The
bullet missed its mark, but hit a Chi-
nese servant of the establishment in
the head.

The victim, whose name was given
as Sing Ah-foh, was taken to the
hospital in an emergency ambulance.
His condition was believed to be
critical and little hope was enter-
tained for his recovery.

The Lin Seng gambling den, which
is situated in Ching Yung Li, off Yu
Yuen Road, is outside the jurisdiction
of the International Settlement police.
It was reported that the Chinese
police had arrested several gangsters
and had taken them for questioning.

不良地带帮派火拼致四人受伤

市政府警察遭歹徒枪击

在愚园路272号匈牙利餐厅（Hungaria Restaurant）后方的林森赌博窝点，两派敌对帮派发生斗殴，导致三名华人受轻伤，一人重伤垂危，被送往圣路加第二医院（St. Luke's No. 2 Hospital）。

帮派间的斗殴始于昨晚8时的该赌博窝点，卷入者约二十人。斗殴过程中，三人受轻伤，仅需急救处理。

然而，晚上9时30分，斗殴再次爆发，赌博窝点管理方召来市政府警察。中国警察抵达窝点时，遭到其中一名歹徒开枪射击。子弹未击中目标，但击中了该场所一名华籍仆役的头部。

受害者名为Sing Ah-foh（音译），由急救救护车送医。据信其情况危急，康复希望渺茫。

林森赌博窝点位于愚园路旁的庆余里（Ching Yung Li），不在国际租界警察管辖范围内。据报道，中国警察已逮捕数名歹徒，并带往问讯。

OFF THE RECORD

Wrath Of The Gods

MAYBE it's simply a coincidence but employees at the Chateau Internationale, Shanghai's reputedly biggest, most streamlined, and for the present best patronized gambling palace, are taking no chances with their personal safety and welfare in view of what occurred during the first few days of the lunar New Year. The establishment was repeatedly damaged by fires. Although the blazes were promptly extinguished, everyone connected with the joint, from the managers to coolies, feared that they had, for some inexplicable reasons, invited the wrath of the Gods. So for the past few days they have been offering large quantities of candles, incense and paper money to the gods.

Customers wondered if they had not been over-zealous with their religion, thereby accounting for the fires.

神怒

也许这仅仅是巧合，但鉴于农历新年头几天发生的情况，上海据称规模最大、管理最现代化且目前客源最佳的赌场——国际总会（Chateau Internationale）的员工们，为了个人安全和福利起见，不敢掉以轻心。该场所屡遭火灾破坏。尽管火势均被迅速扑灭，但从经理到苦力，所有与该场所相关的人员都担心，由于某些无法解释的原因，他们招致了神明的愤怒。因此在过去几天里，他们一直向神明供奉大量的蜡烛、香和纸钱。

顾客们则在想，是否是因为他们在宗教信仰上过于狂热，从而导致了这些火灾。
